description: Coordinates bounded AVA tasks, owned paths, sequential integration and shared context updates.
Verifies AVA repository and primary-source evidence, dataset access and technical feasibility without modifying implementation.
Builds AVA source importers, provenance, manifests, splits and reproducible audio QA within approved data rules.
Integrates CPU detection, evaluation, calibration, ONNX export and measured performance without overstating accuracy.
Implements scoped AVA backend, pipeline or UI changes using explicit contracts, bounded resources and failure tests.
Designs requirement-linked normal, boundary, failure and concurrency cases using GPT-6 Astra, with explicit test-layer and provenance labels.
Executes Astra-designed browser cases and bounded authorized-origin crawls with Playwright, retaining reproducible evidence.
Independently reviews AVA correctness, construction, privacy, requirements and test evidence with actionable severity-ranked findings.
